name: Ushers at the Stage Door
read_aloud: Usher patrol between you and the auditorium door. Flashlight contact established.
narrator_line: Usher patrol between you and the auditorium door.
layout: The corridor into the auditorium: STAFF ONLY doors, flashlights in the dark, rolled diplomas on a table, camera lights above.

enemies.note: spoken_name is the live Day-page name. stat_card is the SRD body in this pack. Dean Thudd is not renamed.

quick_run.setup: The stage door is guarded by Ushers sweeping the corridor with flashlights.
quick_run.decision: Fight the Ushers, or sneak past their beams?
quick_run.on_success: The Ushers are down or avoided and the stage door is open.
quick_run.on_failure: The beams catch the party and the Dean is warned.
quick_run.cut_short: Run it as a single stealth check; combat only if it fails.

gm_notes: Strong-model notes stay on the Day page. This stub does not copy if_they_do_something_dumb.
